fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 10% on Gross Billings up to $1,499,999; 9% on $1,500,000-$2,999,999; 8% on $3,000,000+. Minimum monthly royalty: $750 (months 12-18), $1,000 (months 19-24), $2,000 (month 25+), commencing 12 months after training completion. Default royalty rate increases to 11%. Promotional Fund: 2% of Gross Billings. Technology Fee: $499/month (currently). Other fees include Annual Conference ($975/year), Transfer Fee ($15,000 or $5,000 if existing franchisee), Renewal Fee ($5,000), Local Marketing ($1,000/month minimum for first year), and various other fees itemized in Item 6.
